question: Why can student not load Students (404) in UntisX (endpoint /classes)?
answer: Check role student. Module Students may require higher permissions. Error 404: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /classes and the database connection. Feature Search must be enabled.
